access_matrix.network_requester: Read own requests and submit catalog requests; no access to other users' sensitive request data.
access_matrix.network_approver: Read requests requiring their approval and related approval records; approve/reject through standard approval mechanisms.
access_matrix.network_fulfiller: Read/update requests assigned to their fulfillment group; cannot alter approval decisions.
access_matrix.network_admin: Full administration of the Network Request application and configuration.

acl_principles: Prefer role/group conditions over hard-coded user sys_ids.
Enforce ownership/assignment checks for requester and fulfiller access.
Protect sensitive fields with field-level ACLs where required.
Do not grant wildcard access to all authenticated users.
